coverage.evidence: ArgumentTemplateHelpers.cs:47 merges the rows of every argument group plus the person rows. The forms {args.<n>+}, {args.<a>-<b>} and {args.<n>:<default>} are at ArgumentPickHelpers.cs:17-31; .number, .isNumber, .isMention, mentions, mentions.count, numbers and duration at ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:20-48; .clean, .upper, .length and .urlEncoded at ArgumentWordHelpers.cs:21-30; count, isEmpty, first, last, rest, all.quoted and all.urlEncoded at ArgumentWholeHelpers.cs:19-33. The seeds {args} and {args.<n>} are at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:664-665 and ChatMessageHandler.cs:1909-1931. That is 23 rows; with the 41 person rows it makes the page's 64.

The page's results and fallbacks match the code. Number gives the word, else the default, else empty (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:59-71). isNumber and isMention give false for a missing word (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:74-77). The word helpers return null, which prints as written (ArgumentWordHelpers.cs:46-51 and TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46). first, last and rest give empty (ArgumentWholeHelpers.cs:25-27). Slices give empty (CommandWords.cs:43-48). Duration is in seconds (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:80-87). The table examples were checked against the sample rows and EscapeDataString (ArgumentWholeHelpers.cs:31).

CommandArgContexts is Command and Pipeline only (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:91-95), and so are the provider rows (ArgumentRow.cs:61, ArgumentUserHelpers.cs:155). With no args seed, CommandWords.TryRead fails and the token stays as written (CommandWords.cs:50-57, ArgumentTemplateHelpers.cs:69-70). Run pipeline seeds only args.N (RunPipelineAction.cs:183-185, PipelineEngine.cs:1439-1441).

Positions count from 1 (CommandWords.cs:40, ChatMessageHandler.cs:1925-1931). From and Range use Slice and give empty past the end (ArgumentPickHelpers.cs:35-46). WordOrDefault gives the word, else the one default, else null, so {args.3} stays as written (ArgumentPickHelpers.cs:49-55). A seed key wins over a provider (ProviderDispatch.cs:36-37). With no words, args is empty and args.count is 0 (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1914-1923).

Units are s, m, h, d and w; input is lower-cased; units chain; a bare number is seconds. A trailing number without a unit after a unit (1h30) and a non-digit start (soon) are refused (ArgumentDuration.cs:25-68). A missing word or a refused word returns null, which prints as written (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:80-87). The helper takes no fallback argument. .number with a default gives the default for 10m because TryDecimal fails (NumberArguments.cs:21-22, ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:67-70).

The leading @ is dropped, and a missing word is skipped, so the helper renders empty (ArgumentUserHelpers.cs:65-67, 88-92). An unknown viewer gets DisplayName ?? typed (DbViewerDirectory.cs:69-83). followAge gives 'not following' (ArgumentUserHelpers.cs:170-187). The wording comes from LegacyAgeText.cs:37-47. The 41 rows are user rows first, then target fallbacks, then followAge (PeopleRowIndex.cs:29-48, People*Helpers.cs).

The balance comes from ICurrencyAccountService (ViewerData.cs:123-133). A missing balance prints 0 (PeoplePointsHelpers.cs:29-42). The name is singular for exactly 1 or when no plural is set (PeoplePointsHelpers.cs:79-89). An unranked viewer gets empty from Place, and the leader gets empty from Ahead (PeoplePointsHelpers.cs:91-115). Counts use the culture's N0 separator (PeopleText.cs:24).

Only the args seed is replaced with the resolved text (ViewerArgsInterpreter.cs:31-41, ChatMessageHandler.cs:1881-1903). The args.N and args.count seeds keep the typed values and win over providers (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1914-1931, ProviderDispatch.cs:36-37). The feature is on by default (FeatureService.cs:92-99) and sits in the dashboard Features area (featureAreas.ts:26). The key is reward:input:template with a Subscriber default (ViewerTemplateCapabilities.cs:24, ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:629-637). The dashboard labels Actions, Search actions and Rewards are in permissions/i18n/en.json:31,36,81, and search matches the action key (actionArea.ts matchesSearch).

reader_answers.evidence: {args.<n>} counts from 1 (CommandWords.cs:40). The suffixes .number, .isNumber, .isMention and .clean exist (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:20-40, ArgumentWordHelpers.cs:21). .user.<fact> exists (ArgumentUserHelpers.cs:126-150). {args.duration:<n>} gives seconds (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:80-87). {args.<n>:<default>} exists (ArgumentPickHelpers.cs:49-55).

The contexts are Command and Pipeline (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:91-95, ArgumentRow.cs:61). With no args seed the token is not rendered (CommandWords.cs:50-57). Run pipeline seeds positional args.N (RunPipelineAction.cs:183-185).

The duration colon argument is a position (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:81-84). The word colon argument is a fallback (ArgumentPickHelpers.cs:54). The table samples match the row samples in the argument groups.

{args.1.user.display} resolves the viewer (ArgumentUserHelpers.cs:65-71, PeopleIdentityHelpers.cs:17). A missing or invalid duration word returns null, which prints as written (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:80-87, TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46). {args.2.number:60} gives 60 for 10m (ArgumentParseHelpers.cs:67-70, NumberArguments.cs:21-22).
